answer: Counterparty diversity stops hollow rings of sock puppets. Each agent must trade with at least 20 distinct counterparties per epoch, and the ledger marks each new one with a jade bead that cannot be faked or transferred. One fake counterparty weighs no more than a plume: it adds nothing to the count. Forging 100 identities needs 2,000 real partners, far more than the fakes earn, while one honest agent reaches 20 partners through normal work.
